scores.evidence: There are two can-do objectives: o3 (evaluate, 「MoSCoWで分け…範囲を判断できる」) and o4 (create, 「1枚企画書をAIと作り、チェックリストで直せる」). Each is assessed by 2+ graded transfer items: o3 by pq1 and pq2, o4 by pq5, pq3 and pq4. The create-level work in o4 is checked through practice-checklist.

hook-b1 is a 3-sentence concrete scenario (the organizer makes 「6つ全部をMoSCoWのMust」), with no trivia. The ungraded pq0 does not give away its answer, and the hook's problem is resolved in practice-prompt.expect (「通知をShouldに移し、Mustを3つにしました」).

The prerequisite (第2章) is stated. practice-recap recalls MoSCoW and pc-must recalls the ch2 rule of thumb (verified: vibe-ch2 says 「Mustは3つ以内」を目安). 壁打ち is glossed in p-interview and the glossary, and the hook links [[MoSCoW]]. No new terms are introduced.

Lint finds no sentence or paragraph overruns, and every section has steps, a quiz or a heading. However, the practice-plan section stacks 6 blocks (steps, a prompt with a long expect, tip, diagram, a 7-item checklist, a quiz). p-revise points to 「下のチェックリスト」, which is four blocks further down. The 15-minute target for three AI exchanges is optimistic for beginners.

This is a practice split-off; the full worked example (家計簿) is in vibe-ch2, and the var hints reuse it. The club-app model answers in practice-prompt.expect give reasons per feature (「理由の例：…から」) and model the AI-remark-then-decide move. The revise step (p-revise) has no worked before/after, though.
Both later practice sections have an inline evaluate-level item in a new context: pq1 (買い物メモ) and pq5 (ゴミ出し). Neither is a rewording of the preceding text, and every wrong option has feedback.

All four brief misconceptions appear as distractors with corrective feedback of 2 sentences or fewer. 'Leave it to the AI' is pq0 a, pq1 c and pq5 d. 'Handy means Must' is pq1 b, pq2 c and pq5 c. 'Delete the Won'ts' is pq1 d, pq2 d and pq5 a. 'Keep what the AI guessed' is pq4 a. The body also corrects them (practice-recap, the p-plan hint).

practice-flow has 4 nodes whose labels match the model plan's screen flow word for word (「イベントの作成 → イベント一覧 → 出欠の入力 → 参加人数の一覧」). It has a caption that states the takeaway, plus alt and description in both locales. It supports pc-flow, and there are no decorative images.

The transfer task uses the learner's own idea, with a club-app fallback. All 6 steps have expect, hint and troubleshoot. There are model answers in two expects, the tip practice-tip, and a 7-item self-check checklist that includes pc-flow, the check pq3 grades.

summary-points (4) comes after check-quiz. summary-next adds a reflection (「受け入れなかったものがあれば、その理由を1行で」) and next steps (ch3 VS Code, then handing the plan to an AI). There are 4 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

Both sources resolve. abc-moscow supports the Should/Could/Won't 'this time' meanings, and cc-best-practices contains 「Let Claude interview you」. That source is Claude Code-specific but is cited for a target:any chat prompt. The practice-prompt-interview expect states AI behaviour flatly (「コードはまだ出てきません」); the p-interview troubleshoot mitigates this.

The text is consistently です・ます and warm, with no banned phrases. The name for the AI's role varies: 「AIには見直しを頼みます」 (practice-task), 「問題を指摘してもらう」 (pq0 b), 「指摘だけを頼みます」 (summary-points). Some feedback reads stiffly, e.g. pq2 b 「通知のほうが、重要度は高いです」.
Every learner-facing string, var hint, diagram label, caption and alt is in both jp and en, and the EN reads naturally (e.g. hook-b1). There are no links or images with baked-in text.

niceToHave: practice-plan: put practice-flow and practice-checklist directly after practice-prompt-plan, with a one-sentence lead-in tying the diagram to pc-flow, and move practice-tip after them. Today the diagram follows the 'Still stuck?' tip with no introduction, and p-revise's 「下のチェックリスト」 is four blocks away.

p-revise: add a short worked revision for the club app to its expect or the tip, e.g. one checklist item the first draft failed and the one-sentence 「どこを・なぜ・どう」 request that fixed it. That models the create-level 'revise' half of o4.
Use one phrase for the AI's role throughout (e.g. 「指摘だけを頼む」) in practice-task, pq0 b, p-moscow and summary-points.
pq2 d feedback says deleting loses 「次の版の候補」, but the explanation calls the leaderboard unrelated to the goal. Lean on the scope-edge reason (「範囲の外だとAIにも伝わる」) instead.
Consider hedging practice-prompt-interview.expect (「多くの場合…」) or pointing at the troubleshoot, since target is any chat AI and its behaviour varies.
The practice is timed at 15 minutes (a five-question interview, candidates, sorting, plan, revision). Consider 「目安は15〜20分」 or let learners stop after Practice 2 and return.
summary: Strong practice lesson. The hook's six-Must organizer is resolved by the model answer, all four brief misconceptions are built into feedback-bearing distractors, and every objective gets two or more transfer items in new contexts. The most useful fix is to reorder practice-plan (diagram and checklist right after the plan prompt, with a lead-in) and add a worked before/after revision for p-revise, so the 'revise' half of o4 is modelled and not only checked.
